Check model input before fitting

Source: R/07_model_input.R
pam_check_model_input.Rd

Runs a set of consistency checks on the output of pam_model_input(): dimensions, site and occasion matching, the values of the response and missing values. Use it after editing the input by hand, or to confirm that input is ready before it is passed to a modeling package.

Usage

pam_check_model_input(x, error = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A pam_model_input.

error

If TRUE (the default), a failed check is an error that names the failed checks. If FALSE, the table of checks is returned whatever the result.

Value

A data.table with one row per check: check, passed and detail (invisibly when everything passed).

Details

The checks are: the response is a numeric array; sites are unique and match the site covariates (count and names); observation covariates have the shape of the response; the response holds whole numbers of 0 or more (0 or 1 for detection / non-detection); every site was surveyed at least once; observation covariates are present wherever the response is; and, for seasons, the number of seasons and occasions match the response.

See also

pam_model_input()

Examples

counts <- matrix(c(0, 2, 5, 1, 0, 3), nrow = 3, dimnames = list(c("a", "b", "c"), NULL))
x <- pam_model_input(pam_as_count_history(counts))
#> Error in pam_model_input(pam_as_count_history(counts)): could not find function "pam_model_input"
pam_check_model_input(x)
#> Error in pam_check_model_input(x): could not find function "pam_check_model_input"
